title: YEEZY QUANTUM KIDS
description: The adidas Yeezy Quantum Kids ‘Onyx’ dresses the lifestyle silhouette in neutral black and charcoal tones. They coalesce around a mono mesh upper covered in embroidered detailing and fortified with a synthetic suede toe cap. The remainder of the branding-free build comprises a stretchy neoprene collar and a reinforced heel overlay treated to a reflective finish. The mid-top is mounted on a responsive Boost midsole wrapped in a semi-translucent TPU cage. A herringbone-traction rubber outsole yields grippy traction underfoot.

title: HELMUT LANG BALLISTIC VEST
description:
Background: As with a lot of Yeezy Season pieces, their references come from the Helmut Lang brand. This ballistic vest is likely the most infamous Helmut Lang reference from the Yeezy Season 1 show, and likely all of Yeezy Season's existence.

The Yeezy Season 1 version of the ballistic vest silhouette features simplified shoulder straps, with an extra line of velcro on the stomach. 

The vest was a part of Helmut Lang's SS98 Men's RTW collection, worn in Look 62.
